fields.description: The weekend is over and you need to start fixing your life. Time to get your stuff in order and check more items from your infinite TODO list.
fields.title: FIX

fields.description: “Man-made machines needs to keep the order and balance between what is created and what organically grow by the laws of nature.” As part of texture and layout exploration this piece highlights the proportion between machinery and organic matter to keep a balance of 3.4/8 ratio. This hand drawn original was created in London, UK in 2025.
fields.title: Microcosm!+

fields.description: “Background noise can inspire you to create something different. Keep. your eyes open for hints and clues hidden in obvious places.” This hand drawn illustration was created in London, UK in 2025, inspired by huge crowds of people passing by a very slow traffic light, are they similar, just the same or not equal?.
fields.title: Not Equal

etsy.body: Sabiduría Universal (Universal Understandings), covers the work for Maryland Supreme and Sebastian Andia between 2023-2024. The artwork covered in this printed booklet was produced as a collaboration mixing both styles over more than 40 original drawings.
etsy.title: Sabiduría Universal - 2024 (book , art, drawings)

etsy.body: This booklet covers the works of Maryland Supreme between 2013 and 2023. A wide range of styles and characters are discovered as part of a natural artistic exploration to find shapes and colors that work together.
etsy.title: Maryland Supreme 10th Year Anniversary Catalog 2023 (book , art, drawings)

fields.description: “Living organisms always find a way. Complex structures enabled the creation of complex creatures who not only thrived but consumed chaos to bring control to their environments.” From the micro ring of Sabiduría Universal, the innermost of three rings looking at the creation of matter and how consciousness was born out of the emptiness of space. This hand drawn original was created in London, UK in 2023, as part of Sabiduría Universal, a collaboration between Maryland Supreme and Sebastian Andia.
